title: Redux Action
description: Schema for a Redux action object. Actions are plain JavaScript objects that represent an intention to change the state. Every action must have a type field.

type.description: A string constant identifying the kind of action being performed. By convention written in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.

payload.description: Any data that accompanies the action. Follows the Flux Standard Action convention.

error.description: When true, the payload is treated as an error object. Follows the Flux Standard Action convention.

meta.description: Extra information that is not part of the payload. Follows the Flux Standard Action convention.
